request.system: Determine whether the proposed hypothesis or expression explicitly avoids a failure described in the report. Return JSON only: {"avoids_failure": true|false|null}. Use null when the evidence is unclear.
request.prompt: {"report": "**Migration report**\n\nAcross four submissions, none produced a usable signal. The first interaction, pairing momentum in one flow rate with wage-level momentum, had essentially zero rank correlation (about 0.00, t near 0.1), in both low and high T states. It also had thin coverage, about half. The second was invalid because I used a non-whitelisted transformation, which wasted a slot. Restricting hours momentum to the high-T regime gave a tiny positive correlation (0.01), with no reliable t-statistic. An hours-versus-wage spread in the high-T regime was slightly negative (-0.02, t -0.4). Regime-gated features were highly persistent (0.45-0.50 autocorrelation). Next I would try other variables and lower-persistence constructions.", "hypothesis": "Groups whose V04 flow rate rose more than their V06 stock rate over 12 months (standardized across groups) have higher next-month returns, extending the positive 3- and 6-month versions. Expect positive IC in both T regimes.", "expression": "spread(chg(V04,12),chg(V06,12))"}
